question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to ~$13.0B ±$0.3B (Aug 4, 2026). Over the last six quarters AMD reported 3.0-7.0% above its guidance midpoint (Q1'25 +4.8%, Q2'25 +3.9%, Q3'25 +6.3%, Q4'25 +7.0%, Q1'26 +4.6%, Q2'26 +3.0%). The beat has been shrinking lately, so I centred the median at ~+3.8% ≈ $13.5B. Sell-side consensus is $13.06-13.19B, and analysts usually anchor near guidance. Downside risks: weaker client/gaming results from memory-cost pressure and the timing of the MI450 ramp. Upside: strong AI and server-CPU demand, and Taiwan supply-chain September revenue up 60% YoY. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.

- Q2 2026 guide was $11.2B ±0.3B, actual $11.536B (+3.0% vs midpoint). Q1 2026 guide ~$9.8B, actual $10.253B (+4.6%). Q4'25 guide $9.6B, actual $10.27B (+7.0%). Q3'25 guide $8.7B, actual $9.246B (+6.3%). Q2'25 guide $7.4B, actual $7.685B (+3.9%). Q1'25 guide $7.1B, actual $7.438B (+4.8%). That is 6 of 6 quarters above the midpoint, by 3.0-7.0%; the last two beats were the smallest of the six (+4.6%, +3.0%).
- Consensus (MarketBeat/Tradingpedia, Oct 2026): revenue $13.06B-$13.19B, EPS ~$1.94-1.95.
- Earnings date: Nov 3, 2026 after market close (AMD press release, via StockTitan); one article says Nov 2.
- Taiwan semiconductor September 2026 revenue +60% YoY; IC design revenue -8% MoM on weak PC demand and memory price hikes (UDN, Oct 17, 2026).
- Q1 2026 commentary: consumer/gaming expected to be hurt by rising memory and component costs (Tom's Hardware).
- Status quo: revenue lands within or above the guided $12.7-13.3B range.
- Resolves off the revenue in AMD's Q3 FY2026 earnings release (8-K), not off a later restatement.
- Event window: Q3 quarter ended ~late Sept 2026; release expected Nov 3, 2026. As of Oct 17, the quarter has closed and the result is not yet reported.
- Searched and not found: any pre-announcement or guidance change during the quarter; any prediction market on AMD revenue.

calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on every load-bearing fact: guidance $13.0B±0.3B, a 6-quarter beat history of +3.0-7.0%, consensus ~$13.06-13.2B, no pre-announcement, no market. The only factual disagreement, Nov 2 vs Nov 3 release, has no effect on the resolved figure. The real dispute is how big the beat will be (medians imply +3.5% to +4.0%), which is a judgment call. I widened the reference class with the 2023-24 beats as I recall them (~1-2.4%, not re-verified; no web access this run) and weighed the shrinking recent beats and PC weakness against the MI450 ramp, landing on +3.5%. I carried the runs' dispersion forward with a slight widening for the longer reference class. No web access on this run, so no retrieval.
